websocket.broadcast.description: Sends data to every app connected to Cuebot's WebSocket server, as a General.Custom event. Handy for your own overlays and tools.

parameters.data: What to send, like "{\"alert\": \"raid\"}" or plain text.
parameters.json: Optional. true reads data as JSON and sends it as an object (plain text if it is not valid JSON). Leave it out for false (send as text).

websocket.clientConnect.description: Connects one of your WebSocket clients (set up on the Servers page). Does nothing when it is already connected. Fails when no client matches.

parameters.connection: Which WebSocket client from the Servers page: its number in the list (0 is the first), its name or its id. Leave it out for 0.

websocket.clientDisconnect.description: Disconnects one of your WebSocket clients. Fails when no client matches.

parameters.connection: Which WebSocket client from the Servers page: its number in the list (0 is the first), its name or its id. Leave it out for 0.

websocket.clientIndex.description: Finds the number of a WebSocket client in the list on the Servers page, by its name.
websocket.clientIndex.returns: Its number (0 is the first), or -1 when no client has that name.

websocket.clientIsConnected.description: Checks whether one of your WebSocket clients is connected right now. Fails when no client matches.

parameters.connection: Which WebSocket client from the Servers page: its number in the list (0 is the first), its name or its id. Leave it out for 0.

websocket.clientIsConnected.returns: true when it is connected, otherwise false.

websocket.clientSend.description: Sends a message through one of your WebSocket clients. Fails when no client matches.

parameters.connection: Which WebSocket client from the Servers page: its number in the list (0 is the first), its name or its id. Leave it out for 0.

websocket.clientSend.returns: true when it was sent, false when the client is not connected.

websocket.serverBroadcast.description: Sends a message to the apps connected to one of your custom WebSocket servers. Fails when the server is not running.

parameters.connection: Which custom WebSocket server from the Servers page: its number in the list (0 is the first), its name or its id. Leave it out for 0.
parameters.sessionId: Optional. Send only to this one connection (its session id). Leave it out for everyone.

websocket.serverCloseAll.description: Disconnects every app connected to one of your custom WebSocket servers. The server keeps running.

parameters.connection: Which custom WebSocket server from the Servers page: its number in the list (0 is the first), its name or its id. Leave it out for 0.

websocket.serverCloseAll.returns: How many connections were closed (0 when the server is not running).

websocket.serverCloseSession.description: Disconnects one app from one of your custom WebSocket servers.

parameters.connection: Which custom WebSocket server from the Servers page: its number in the list (0 is the first), its name or its id. Leave it out for 0.
parameters.sessionId: The session id of the connection to close, like the %sessionId% of a custom server trigger.

websocket.serverCloseSession.returns: true when it was closed, false when there is no such connection or the server is not running.

websocket.serverIndex.description: Finds the number of a custom WebSocket server in the list on the Servers page, by its name.
websocket.serverIndex.returns: Its number (0 is the first), or -1 when no server has that name.

websocket.serverIsListening.description: Checks whether one of your custom WebSocket servers is running.

parameters.connection: Which custom WebSocket server from the Servers page: its number in the list (0 is the first), its name or its id. Leave it out for 0.

websocket.serverIsListening.returns: true when it is running, otherwise false.

websocket.serverStart.description: Starts one of your custom WebSocket servers, so other apps can connect. Fails when no server matches.

parameters.connection: Which custom WebSocket server from the Servers page: its number in the list (0 is the first), its name or its id. Leave it out for 0.

websocket.serverStop.description: Stops one of your custom WebSocket servers. Connected apps are disconnected.

parameters.connection: Which custom WebSocket server from the Servers page: its number in the list (0 is the first), its name or its id. Leave it out for 0.
